```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

baseball_data <- read.csv("statcast_data.csv")
head(baseball_data)
```

```{r}
# Extract the types of events that have occurred and been recorded over the past 10 years
list_of_events <- unique(baseball_data$events)
list_of_events

# Create a vector of hit events
hit_events <- c("single", "double", "triple", "home_run")

# Create a vector of non-AB events (don't count towards batting average)
non_ab_events <- c("walk", "intent_walk", "hit_by_pitch", "sac_fly", "sac_bunt", 
                   "sac_bunt_double_play", "sac_fly_double_play", "truncated_pa",
                   "catcher_interf", "game_advisory", "ejection")

# Subsetting data to only include regular season and playoff games
game_types <- unique(baseball_data$game_type)
game_types

# Vector of only regular season and playoff game types
reg_playoff <- c("R", "D", "L", "W")

# Subsetting data to only include regular season and playoff games
baseball_data <- baseball_data |>
  filter(game_type %in% reg_playoff)
```

```{r}
# Creating a dataset with only PAs that count as ABs
AB_only_data <- baseball_data |>
  # Filtering out events that do not count as an AB
  filter(!(events %in% non_ab_events))

# Creating a summary of aggregated batting average per year
BA_overall_summary <- AB_only_data |>
  group_by(game_year) |>
  # Calculate each year's average batting average
  summarize(batting_average = mean(events %in% hit_events) |> round(digits = 4))

BA_overall_summary

# Creating a scatter plot of overall batting average versus year
BA_overall_plot <- ggplot(BA_overall_summary, aes(x = game_year, y = batting_average)) +
  # Plotting the points
  geom_point(color = "salmon", size = 2) + 
  # Plotting a line of best fit
  geom_smooth(size = 0.4, method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey") +
  # Forcing the x-axis into one-year breaks
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2025) +
  labs(title = "MLB Batting Average (2015-2025)",
       x = "Season",
       y = "Batting Average") +
  theme_classic()

BA_overall_plot
```

```{r}
# Computing linear regression statistics on batting average versus year
BA_linear_regression <- lm(batting_average ~ game_year, data = BA_overall_summary)
summary(BA_linear_regression)
```

```{r}
# Analyzing all types of pitches in the AB only data
unique(AB_only_data$pitch_name)

# Deducing the total number of pitches/proportion of each type from 2015-2025
pitch_count <- AB_only_data |>
  group_by(pitch_name) |>
  summarize(total = n(), prop = round(n()/nrow(AB_only_data), 3)) |>
  # Arranging in order from most common to least common pitch types
  arrange(desc(total))

print(pitch_count)

# Deducing the total percentage of pitches thrown that the 
# six most common pitches make up
common_pitches_prop <- sum(pitch_count$prop[1:6])
common_pitches_prop

# Creating a vector of the six most common pitch types
desired_pitches <- c()
for(i in 1:6){
  desired_pitches[i] <- pitch_count$pitch_name[i]
}
```

```{r}
# Creating a summary of batting average per pitch per year
BA_by_pitch_summary <- AB_only_data |>
  # Choosing the desired (six most common) pitches
  filter(pitch_name %in% desired_pitches) |>
  group_by(game_year, pitch_name) |>
  # Calculating/summarizing the batting average per pitch type
  summarize(batting_average = mean(events %in% hit_events) |> round(digits = 4))

BA_by_pitch_summary

# Plotting the batting average per pitch type
ggplot(BA_by_pitch_summary, aes(x = game_year, y = batting_average, color = pitch_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2025) +
  geom_smooth(size = 0.6, method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "MLB Batting Average by Pitch Type (2015-2025)",
       x = "Season",
       y = "Batting Average",
       color = "Pitch Type") +
  theme_classic()
```
